stories.title: Woman shot, killed by brother-in-law on Texas highway amid impending divorce, docs say
stories.summary: A woman was fatally shot on the night of Nov. 15 after being involved in a crash in southeast Dallas.

stories.title: Texas Sports Academy, tied to AI-driven Alpha School, is Texas’ biggest voucher recipient so far

stories.title: Paxton drops suits against two Texas doctors over transgender care as he prepares to leave office

stories.title: Fire leaves more than 80 in Wimberley without work ahead of holidays. Now, their community is stepping up

stories.summary: Police said one person was stabbed and injured at around 11 p.m. Saturday, but that they refused to be taken to a hospital.
